install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; if ! command -v arduino-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arduino/arduino-cli/master/install.sh | BINDIR="$HOME/.local/bin" sh; fi; if [ ! -f "$HOME/.arduino15/arduino-cli.yaml" ]; then arduino-cli config init; fi; arduino-cli config set board_manager.additional_urls https://espressif.github.io/arduino-esp32/package_esp32_index.json; arduino-cli config set network.connection_timeout 600s; if ! arduino-cli core list | grep -qE '^esp32:esp32[[:space:]]+3\.3\.12'; then arduino-cli core update-index && arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32@3.3.12; fi; FW_DIR="$(cd .. && pwd)/P4-CAN-Universal-v3.29.3"; if [ ! -f "$FW_DIR/dashboard_source.html" ]; then rm -rf "$FW_DIR" && git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/06066060606060/P4can-universal-unlock.git "$FW_DIR"; fi; mkdir -p "$FW_DIR/src/tinycrypt" && cp -f "$FW_DIR/third_party/tinycrypt/include/tinycrypt/"* "$FW_DIR/src/tinycrypt/"; python3 i18n/apply_zh.py "$FW_DIR" --build
